cases.name: Disposable HTTP server starts with plugin enabled
Normal host preserves legacy root discovery
Official SDK proactively discovers the issuer from only the MCP URL before any 401 challenge
Proactive discovery uses the path-specific protected resource and RFC8414 issuer documents
MCP HTTP 401 advertises Bearer resource metadata
Protected resource discovery matches MCP audience and stable REST issuer
Official MCP SDK discovers exact issuer and mandatory S256 metadata
Official SDK uses first standard discovery URL when host permits it
Canonical RFC8414 discovery route returns the stable issuer and registration endpoint
REST metadata responses remain uncached
HTTP dynamic client registration succeeds without manually provisioned credentials
Authorization sends an anonymous user to native WordPress login
Native WordPress login succeeds using the synthetic account
Bundled JalinWP logo is served as a PNG
Authenticated authorization renders an explicit consent form
Consent explicitly describes YOLO access without dashboard approval
Consent page CSP permits only this registered client origin and same-site forms
Consent contains a named approval control
Consent returns a code, state and exact issuer to the registered chatgpt callback
Consent POST redirect preserves the same restrictive client-specific CSP
HTTP authorization code exchange returns access and refresh tokens
Bearer token initializes MCP through a real HTTP request
Consented OAuth connection advertises immediate YOLO writes
OAuth write applies in its original HTTP tool call without dashboard approval
Applied YOLO change is visible to its OAuth connection
Reviewed apply tool cannot repeat the YOLO change
Created OAuth draft can be read in the next request
OAuth grant executes a WordPress read tool over HTTP
Gateway bearer does not authenticate ordinary WordPress REST routes
HTTP refresh rotates the refresh token
Refreshed access token remains usable
Reused refresh token is rejected
Refresh replay revokes the associated active access grant

stack: WordPress 6.8.8 / PHP 8.3 / SQLite / local HTTP reverse proxy with fixture-only HTTPS recognition
limits: Not a live GridPane host, native MySQL, real TLS, browser automation or actual ChatGPT/Claude connection.
Official MCP SDK exercises discovery only. The remaining OAuth flow uses a local synthetic HTTP client with the documented hosted callback. No authorization code is sent to the real callback.

GridPane-static mode models an unanchored well-known path interception serving two owned metadata files, including extensionless JSON as application/octet-stream; host-specific WAF/CDN policies are not simulated.
